 proof['source_witnesses'].append({'path':str(f),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'text':f.read_text()})

def render(v,depth=0):
 pad='  '*depth
 if isinstance(v,dict):return '{\n'+',\n'.join('  '*(depth+1)+json.dumps(k)+': '+render(x,depth+1) for k,x in v.items())+'\n'+pad+'}'
 if isinstance(v,list):
  if not v or all(not isinstance(x,(dict,list)) for x in v):return json.dumps(v)
  if all(isinstance(x,dict) and ('index' in x or 'target_index' in x) for x in v):return '[\n'+',\n'.join('  '*(depth+1)+json.dumps(x,separators=(',',':')) for x in v)+'\n'+pad+']'
  return '[\n'+',\n'.join('  '*(depth+1)+render(x,depth+1) for x in v)+'\n'+pad+']'
 return json.dumps(v)
